name: VPSnet
shortDescription: Manage VPSnet servers, applications, DNS, private networks and Functions with customer-selected services and OAuth permissions.
description: Connect AI clients to existing VPSnet services through customer OAuth. Inspect servers and applications, diagnose Linux VMs, manage permitted DNS and private-network settings, and work with Functions. File changes and commands require explicit permissions on selected services. The hosted directory profile excludes purchases, billing and account API-key management.
pricingNote: A VPSnet account is required. Underlying VPSnet services have their own prices.
